summary: Corrected a stale statement in the interface account rather than leaving it contradicted by my own later evidence. One counterevidence item still claimed the change under test was a single command and that other commands were unmeasured; it now records which commands were measured (a voter address change, an AddNonvoter, a RemoveServer) and which were not (DemoteVoter and the deprecated Promote command, which produce the same log entry type and take the same apply path). I moved that boundary into the limitations list, dropped a redundant restatement of the evidence from that list, and pointed the recorded knowledge use at the Fact's current revision instead of the revision it was submitted with. No evidence changed hands and no execution was requested. With about 25 minutes left, the six questions all carry accounts with receipts — four defects asserted (the verify quorum counting a non-voter with a demonstrated stale read, the transfer to a non-voter reporting success for a handover that cannot complete, VerifyLeader futures stranded after Shutdown pinned by a BatchApplyCh flip, and StoreConfiguration never firing for a batching FSM across three commands) and two leads refuted with their counterevidence recorded.
